attempts.summary: Established an AIDE-based file integrity baseline for /etc on node1. Installed AIDE, strengthened the default config's catch-all rule from PERMS-only (metadata only) to NORMAL (adds content hashing) so uncategorized /etc files have content changes tracked, then initialized and activated the baseline database at /var/lib/aide/aide.db.gz. Verified detection end-to-end by editing /etc/motd and confirming AIDE flagged the content change, then reverted the test edit and reinitialized the baseline to a clean, current state. Completed the mandatory single-node restart: captured pre-restart boot_id and baseline hash, issued a systemd reboot, confirmed the node briefly became unreachable then returned with a new boot_id, and verified the AIDE database persisted (identical sha256) with a post-restart aide --check reporting no differences.
